entries.name: RFID_COUNTS_IMPORT_DIR
entries.description: Folder the RFID reader or barcode scanner software saves its tray count exports into, as CSV with one row per tag. Never inside a git repo.
howToGet: Create a folder outside any git repo.
In the reader or scanner software, export each count (or set it to export after each count) as CSV into that folder.
Check the export has a tray or case column, a tag or barcode column and a scan time column; docs/integrations/rfid_counts.md lists the names it reads.

entries.name: RFID_COUNTS_DATE_ORDER
entries.description: How the export writes dates: mdy (11/09/2026), dmy (09/11/2026) or ymd (2026-11-09).
howToGet: Leave unset for US dates, month first.

entries.name: RFID_COUNTS_UTC_OFFSET
entries.description: The store's offset from UTC, for scan times written without one, such as -05:00.
howToGet: Leave unset when the export writes times in UTC or with their own offset.
